        "All 981 owned diff lines across 18 test/helper paths were read. promise_modal_dialog imports/export are removed; callers migrate to explicit document-URI promiseAlertDialog or promiseAlertDialogOpen calls, and two nonmodal message tasks use domWindowOpenedAndLoaded predicates. Current test strings remain; no fresh current production-chain or live failure claim.",
        "The subscribe helper preserves its component condition wait for a disabled stopButton, then awaits aFunction and closes the dialog; menu triggering and outer promise await remain sequential. At fixed source its old helper path is absent, so no current subscribe helper equivalence is asserted.",
        "Six moved image/send assertion bodies have nonempty expected messages. Image callbacks check radio selection/persistence and send-error callback checks Invalid Recipient Address title; these are direct checks, not platform accessibility/network success. The unchanged name assertion in the affected attachment-renaming task has no explicit message; callback expect/nearby comments do not supply it. No assertion is rewritten here.",
        "Filter callbacks keep concrete field writes, KEY_Enter/idle yield, accept/close and address-book count=2 assertion. The author reports Good try and the review records acceptance/landing; these historical events do not establish URI correctness or toolkit completion equivalence.",
